faq: Which chart libraries do you use?
Usually Chart.js, Recharts or ECharts, depending on your stack. We choose one that is light, accessible and easy for your developers to maintain.
Do you decide which charts to build?
We suggest them. Send us the questions you want answered and we propose the chart type for each. You approve the list before we build, so nothing is wasted.
Can you connect to Google Analytics or Stripe data?
Yes, through their official APIs, if you give us access as a collaborator. We confirm what data is available first, because some tools limit what they expose.
Are the numbers checked for accuracy?
Yes. We compare each chart against your raw data on a sample and share the check with you. We cannot fix numbers that are wrong at the source, but we point them out.
